user.title: Burgenland Energie customer portal
user.description:
The portal login is protected by a captcha, so Home Assistant takes over an existing portal session via its refresh token.

1. Sign in at meine.burgenlandenergie.at and tick **Angemeldet bleiben** (stay signed in).
2. Create a bookmark with this address and click it on the portal page - the token is copied to the clipboard:

`{bookmarklet}`

   Alternatively: developer tools (F12) → Console → `copy(localStorage.getItem('okc-auth-refreshToken'))`
3. Paste the token here.

Do not sign out of the portal afterwards, or the token becomes invalid.

data_description.refresh_token: Long text from the portal (about 1,900 characters). Stored only in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew portal session
reauth_confirm.description:
The portal no longer accepts the stored token (for example after signing out). Sign in again and copy the token as during setup:

`{bookmarklet}`

error.invalid_token: This does not look like a refresh token. Paste the complete text without spaces.
error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected the token. Sign in again and copy the current token.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different customer account.

abort.already_configured: This customer account is already configured.
